note: Refero Styles — design-style and design-system reference guides. Items are the 51 named pages: /design-styles/<style> (11 curated style guides, e.g. 'Clean SaaS Design Examples'), /ai-agents/<name> (23 AI-agent design prompt/checklist pages, e.g. cursor-design-prompts, agentic-ui-quality-checklist), /design-md/<name> (13 DESIGN.md docs: specification, template, comparisons) and /examples/<name> (4, e.g. pricing-page-design). The 1342-page family /style/<uuid> ('Grafana Labs design system', name only in the h1) is left out on purpose: the slug is a UUID, so item names would be UUIDs — a name source (page title/h1) is the tool change that would unlock them.
